pages.title: Wondering Trader
pages.text: The true form of this merchant will only be revealed with $(#AA00AA)Third Eye$() or $(item)Otherworld Goggles$(),$(br) otherwise, he is identical to a common Wandering Trader,$(br) perhaps you have already encountered one without realizing it.$()

pages.title: Wondering Trader
pages.text: $(br2) $(br) The first time you interact with him, mundane sales are always shown.$(br) These vendors love trying to sell everything they have.$(br)
